## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- Operating-system authority routes
- sets, lists, and clears backend hot jobs
- feeds backend hot jobs into employee bootstrap when body hot jobs are omitted
- returns a planner workspace with requested thread selection
- supports email-based identity selection for messages workspace
- fails closed when hot-job mutation requests omit jobId
